name: edit_context
description: Mutate a role's message list to reduce token usage. Supports three operations applied in order: drop (remove a range of messages), strip_reasoning (clear reasoning blocks on a range), and replace (overwrite one message's content). Without targetRole the operations apply to your own conversation; with targetRole they apply to that suspended role instance's conversation. Message indices 0 (system prompt) and 1 (original task) are protected in every operation. Returns the new estimated prompt tokens and message count.

detailed: Mutates the conversation to reduce token usage.

whimsical: {source} is taking shears to the backlog

targetRole.description: Optional role-instance id (for example "coder-1-4") of a suspended role whose conversation should be edited. Must name a live instance other than your own. Omit to edit your own conversation.

operations.description: Ordered list of operations to apply.

range.description: For drop/strip_reasoning: a two-element [start, end) range of message indices — from start up to but not including end. Ignored for replace.

index.description: For replace: the message index to overwrite.

content.description: For replace: the new message content.
